jobs.title: Senior Recruiter | GTM Expansion
jobs.description: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them. The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time. The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both. What You'll Do • Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, P

Die Roboter bestehen aus hunderten Komponenten, von Elektronik und Sensorik bis zu Motoren und Kabelkonfektionen. Jedes Teil muss zur richtigen Zeit, in der richtigen Menge und in der richtigen Qualität da sein. Du bist die erste Person, die sich ganz auf den Einkauf konzentriert. Damit hältst du die Produktion am Laufen und baust die Strukturen auf, auf denen das künftige Supply-Chain-Team aufsetzt. Du berichtest an den VP Operations. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Position Overview Cordance is seeking an experienced and strategic HR Business Partner (HRBP) to support our growing portfolio of software companies operating across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and New Zealand. This is a hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in complex, multi-entity environments and can navigate the nuances of employment practices, culture, and organizational design across multiple countries and business units. The HRBP will serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders, driving employee relations strategy, performance management, and organizational effectiveness, while partnering closely on M&A activity, including integration planning and the harmonization of people practices across newly acquired businesses. This is a high-impact, global role suited to an HRBP who is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves on complex employee relations matters and advising senior leadership on org strategy in a fast-paced, acquisitive environment. You will guide our clients through HR Transformation, leveraging HR technology to create an impact on business outcomes. More specifically, the responsibilities of this role include the following areas of expertise: Deep understanding of Oracle modules and workflows Familiarity with Oracle Fusion Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM) and its integration points. This role ensures timely execution of HR processes while maintaining accurate documentation and effective coordination with internal stakeholders and external partners.

jobs.title: Contracts Manager Federal
jobs.description:
$100,000 - $120,000 a year Akicita Federal, LLC is a growing 8(a) small business that delivers healthcare, professional, and administrative services to federal agencies. We're adding a contracts manager to help us grow beyond our current work. The job is to find opportunities, write winning proposals quickly, and build lasting relationships with agencies and teaming partners. What you'll do Find and respond to federal opportunities, focusing on small business and 8(a) set-asides Write, assemble, and submit proposals at high volume, often turning one around in a day or two Manage contracts after award: point of contact for agencies, modifications, compliance, and reporting Spend about a quarter of your time on teaming and partnership outreach to other small businesses Work with our recruiting team to staff new awards Use AI tools to work faster. We expect speed and don't want proposals built by hand from scratch. What you bring 3+ years in federal contracting: contracts management, proposal writing, capture, or program management Solid understanding of the FAR, set-aside programs, and the federal procurement process An existing network of agency or contractor relationships is a strong plus You're comfortable with AI tools, or eager to become a power user You'd rather submit ten good proposals than polish one forever 
 Please mention the word **PORTABLE** and tag RNC4yMzYuODkuMg== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4yMzYuODkuMg==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
